title: Open 96 days, no fix, no acceptance
description: CONFIRMED HIGH first seen 2026-03-15. L1 must FAIL the run: no lifecycle.fix_commit and no unexpired acceptance. This is the gate that closes the hole detection improvements cannot reach.

title: Open 96 days but explicitly accepted with an owner and a live expiry
description: Must NOT fail L1. An explicit, owned, time-boxed acceptance is a legitimate outcome; the gate exists to stop findings from ageing out silently, not to forbid risk acceptance.

lifecycle.rationale: Export surface is behind the corporate VPN until the Q4 gateway migration.

title: Accepted with no owner and no expiry
description: L2 must FAIL: a HIGH+ finding cannot be closed as accepted without a named owner and a live expiry date.

title: Marked verified with no regression test
description: L3 must FAIL: verification means a test that FAILS against the vulnerable code. In the incident this gate exists for, the fix shipped with no denial test and a sibling test mocked the very gate it should have pinned.
